decisions.decision: Plan 05 pivoted from automated Wave A push to manual /dev/melisma-editor with per-tune decision log
decisions.rationale: Haiku 4.5 Vision OCR could not reliably detect underlines at quality threshold; gate would never have passed

decisions.decision: Bulk syllable overrides written into existing lyrics_structured.lines[].syllables — NOT a new column
decisions.rationale: stanza-cycles.ts already reads Line.syllables → propagates everywhere (public renderer + editor + audio) without new wiring

decisions.decision: Per-tune raw-solfège edits stored in new tunes.solfege_soprano_edited column (not via lyrics_structured)
decisions.rationale: Solfège source is per-tune music data, not per-psalm lyrics. Editor needs separate storage from immutable OCR for Revert-to-OCR.

decisions.decision: Effingham re-OCR uses Sonnet 4.6, not the standard Haiku 4.5
decisions.rationale: Haiku missed the second music system on multi-system pages. Sonnet captured cleanly. Future improvement: auto-retry with Sonnet when Haiku output looks truncated relative to meter.

decisions.decision: Edit ops use effectiveAbc (with auto-injected PHRASE_BREAKs) as base, not tune.abcNotation
decisions.rationale: phraseIdx in the rendered grid must match phraseIdx in the operation target. Bare ABC has no breaks → all tokens parse as phraseIdx=0 → inserts land at end of piece.
